name: Filament
summary: A dark sign-in page with a sleepy light bulb: pull the cord to switch on the light and the form
about: A sign-in page that starts in a dark room with a sleeping vintage bulb. Drag or press the pull cord and the filament flickers, the bulb wakes up, a cone of warm light opens and the form rises into it. The bulb follows your typing, dims and looks away for the password, flickers red on a wrong login and bursts into rays and sparks when you sign in.
how: The page opens in the dark with the bulb asleep and a glowing bead on the pull cord
Drag the bead down (or press it with Enter or Space) to switch the light on: flicker, yawn, then the form rises into the light
Type your email and the bulb leans and looks along the text, glowing brighter with each key
Focus the password and it dims and turns away; press the eye button and it peeks with one flickering eye
Sign in with hira@demo.pk and glow1234 for the flash, rays and sparks, or try other details to see it flicker red and sag
Pull the cord again to switch the light off; the form fades back into the dark
